queries: OpenAI Operator launch Pro users research preview January 2025

sources_considered.why: Primary source. It shows what agent product OpenAI offered before the post and how it was described (a limited research preview).

receipt.public_excerpt: Starting today, Operator is available to Pro⁠(opens in a new window) users in the U.S. at operator.chatgpt.com⁠(opens in a new window). This research preview allows us to learn from our users

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI offered a browser agent to paying Pro users in the U.S. as a limited research preview. This shows a product existed, but it does not settle whether the product was 'marketable' in the speaker's commercial sense.

unresolved_gaps: There is no agreed public test for whether an agent product was commercially 'marketable' in April 2025.
